instruction: From Home open Cố vấn học tập. Tap the 'Môn' level chip. Tap 'Hỏi nhanh trên thiết bị · không cần mạng' to open the quick-question sheet. Tap the 'Chọn môn' dropdown once to open its course list; 'PRM393 — Mobile Programming' is a row near the top of that list. Tap that PRM393 row directly by its visible text to select it — do not tap the dropdown field again while the list is open, and do not use element-index clicks. Then tap 'Tóm tắt môn học'. Read the resulting card and report its literal answer and source line; it must ground credits/prerequisites in Firebase and disclose missing personal data.
